{{Otheruses|Floater}}
'''Floaters''' were aerial [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]] used by the military and residents of [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]]. Although not as fast or capable of attaining the same altitude as a [[Galan starfighter]], floaters used by the military were armed with [[Missile/Legends|missiles]] and [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] that could be used to attack the opposing [[Melida/Legends|Melida]] or [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]] forces and defend their own territory. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] flew against at least seven floaters with [[Nield]] and [[Cerasi]] while destroying the [[deflection tower]]s used to operate [[Particle shield/Legends|particle shields]] that protected the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Zehava]] from intruders.<ref name="DotD">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Defenders of the Dead]]''</ref>
